description: On the table there’s a red plastic cup on the right, a purple toothbrush, and a small toothpaste tube/packet near the center. The right hand lifts the toothbrush out of the cup and holds it steady in front, while the left hand picks up the toothpaste tube, brings its nozzle over the bristles, and squeezes out toothpaste onto the brush head before pulling the tube back.
